name: workshop
notes: Deny-floor division of labor (issue #1293, resolved): the GLOBAL harness floor (~/.claude/hooks/dispatch.py, wired PreToolUse/Bash) owns the universal irreversible rules (force-push --force/-f/+refspec, rm -rf / Remove-Item on ABSOLUTE dangerous paths & roots, sudo, pipe-to-shell, .env/.pem/credential secret mutation). The repo overlay scripts/agent_hooks/pre_tool_use.py is now a THIN complement that owns ONLY what the global floor does not hard-deny at T3: the stricter work-loss HARD-DENY (reset --hard / clean -f / checkout -- <path> / restore -W), repo-specific denies (rmdir /s, npm publish, dotnet ef database drop, DROP TABLE/DATABASE, chmod -R 777), broad secret-file mutation the global .env/.pem set misses, git push --force-with-lease, and recursive delete of ./..//..-escaping paths. This matters because Taskdeck runs bypassPermissions (settings.local.json): native permissions.deny is skipped and the global floor only ASKS on work-loss at T3 (ask == auto-allow under bypass), so the overlay is the only bypass-proof enforcer of the post-2026-05/06 worktree-main-leak posture. The two floors are non-overlapping by design (double-spawn accepted per #1293). settings.json deny[] is kept as belt-and-suspenders for any non-bypass session. In-project recursive deletes of a named subdir (node_modules, dist) are intentionally relaxed deny->allow to match the safer global model.
